Hi Stephanie,
Thanks for the response. We were going to see if any Missions were interested in FB's capabilities to further their COVID
response -is that something we still should pursue, or would you prefer us not to given your lack of inbound request
options? Would love your thoughts.

On Mon, Jun 7, 2021 at 4:19 PM Stephanie Sasser { [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Thanks Rahima. Most of the solutions in this doc are either handled onour side e.g. pulling content from health
authorities into the COVID Info Center, or are self-serve e.g. governments using the WhatsApp APl to build chatbots.
So there isn't much that requires direct coordination with a team at FB other than receiving ad credits, though
Hope this helps!
Stephanie
From: Rahima Dosani <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Monday, June 7, 2021 3:11 PM
To: Stephanie Sasser & [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Cc: Rachel Wood <[contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: Time to chat with USAID re: COVID response?
Hi Stephanie,
I made your requested changes; thanks again for reviewing the document. Just to clarify, when you say that FB doesn't
have a mechanism for inbound country requests, is there a plan to change that? Or is there another way that countries
can engage with FB? On our call you mentioned an interest to engage with public sector partners, so just curious.
Also, does FB have any interest or plans to match funds for governments wanting to do this type of work? Really
appreciate your time and answers in all of this!
Best,
Rahima
